mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 2.0% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with UNRATE > 4.5% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signal a broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS declining or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in industrial production signals an impending economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of late-cycle expansion periods with INDPRO decline or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 3.5% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in nonfarm payrolls signals robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with positive PAYEMS change or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in housing starts signals a weakening housing market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of late-cycle expansion periods with HOUST decline or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and rising federal funds rates signal aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods meeting trigger condition or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
